newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen staging rebound.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen staging rebound.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks could stage a rebound on Tuesday in line with Wall Street's overnight rally, but near-term upside looks limited, brokers said.

"It would be natural to expect to recoup some of its (Hong Kong's) losses after Wall Street's rebound," said a broker at BZW Securities. "But sentiment is uneasy and 200 to 300 points upside in the short term looks like the maximum."
The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 60.21 points, or 0.94 percent, to 6,451.90 following reports of better-than- expected corporate earnings on Monday.
